title: Team Collaboration and File Management System (CollabSync)
overview: CollabSync is a web-based workspace application designed to consolidate team chat, file sharing, and lightweight task tracking into a single platform. It allows small to medium teams to communicate in real time, organize files with metadata and deadlines, and manage user roles within dedicated workspaces.
